result: ProjectionLayoutRenderer now renders the canonical split node as exactly two recursively trusted child regions, preserving Core orientation, ratio, first-child/second-child order, and no locally invented geometry. The generated node validators and recursive identity guard reject malformed split DTOs, duplicate node or contribution identities, omitted/foreign contributions, unknown renderer or semantic bindings, missing authority, and shared child objects before any split wrapper or child geometry is created. The renderer remains projection-only: it does not maintain a local canonical ratio, drag state, eligibility resolver, Workstream authority, or mutation path; Desktop layout mutations remain routed through the generated focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate client seam.

implementation: ProjectionLayoutRenderer validates each recursive LayoutNode against the checked-in generated node DTO validator before rendering it.

The recursive renderability guard preserves Core's two-child SplitLayoutNode contract, rejects invalid orientation/ratio, and rejects duplicate node identities, duplicate contribution identities, and shared child objects instead of rendering duplicate geometry.

Every split child must resolve by exact contribution ID and trusted renderer_binding_id/semantic_binding_id; the component never filters, reflows, substitutes, or repairs an omitted or untrusted child.

Split CSS uses exactly two tracks and the canonical projection ratio without clamping or inventing a tail count; bounded data attributes expose the canonical orientation and ratio for runtime verification.

No local drag, local layout store, or direct canonical mutation path was added. Existing Desktop runtime mutation ownership remains the generated MissionCanvasClient.layoutMutate operation, not the recursive renderer.

negative_cases.unknown_orientation_or_ratio: A split with an unknown orientation or a ratio outside the Core/generated 0.1–0.9 contract produces no layout-split, split-child, or contribution host.
negative_cases.wrong_child_count: A split with three children is rejected as a unit; the renderer does not render the valid prefix or leave a partial split gap.
negative_cases.unknown_layout_field: A split carrying an ungenerated field is rejected by the generated SplitLayoutNode validator rather than being interpreted locally.
negative_cases.duplicate_node_or_contribution_identity: Duplicate node IDs, duplicate contribution IDs, and a shared child object fail closed before geometry is emitted.
negative_cases.omitted_or_foreign_contribution: A child pointing at an omitted or foreign-keyed contribution creates no split wrapper or child geometry; the renderer does not repair the map or infer a replacement.
negative_cases.unknown_renderer_or_semantic_binding: A child with an unknown renderer binding or non-allowlisted semantic binding is rejected before any split host is created.
negative_cases.missing_authority: A child without its generated AuthorityDescriptor is rejected by the trusted renderer resolver and leaves no split geometry.
negative_cases.foreign_workstream_attachment_stale_revi: These authority-bearing conditions remain owned by generated transport/Core/controller seams. Existing hostile projection-controller, transport, event, invalidation, capability, and omission checks reject them before canonical projection data reaches this renderer; no local scope or freshness inference was added.
negative_cases.local_mutation: The renderer has no local canonical layout state or drag commit path. Desktop's existing layout mutation runtime calls generated MissionCanvasClient.layoutMutate with exact authority and revision/idempotency fields; the projection renderer only renders the returned canonical tree.

acceptance: Split orientation and ratio render from the canonical projection, with exactly two ordered child regions.
Omitted contribution IDs cannot leave DOM nodes, headings, borders, or reserved split geometry.
Unknown semantic or renderer binding fails closed; no substitute panel is rendered.
Duplicate or malformed split geometry fails closed rather than rendering a partial tree.
Resize/layout mutation ownership remains generated/Core-owned through focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate; the Svelte renderer does not change canonical layout locally.
